3337.title: Assistant authentication codes disappear at turn completion
3337.rootCauseOneLine: Assistant error codes are not retained for result classification; the generic result subtype becomes unknown.

prReviews.topFinding: Diff addresses classification and recovery affordance; PR code was not executed.

3337.proposedFix: Retain validated error codes within the turn and expose explicit recovery using existing terminal capabilities.
3337.caveats: Live OAuth expiry and desktop interaction were not exercised. Existing PR #3338 prevents a duplicate fix.
